hazards.evidence: Loose area rug on the carpet at the foot/right side of the bed is wrinkled and bunched up with curled edges, sitting in the walking path between the bed and the doorway — a trip/catch hazard for a walker.
Loose rug/runner on the floor in the hallway just through the bedroom doorway (on the route toward the bathroom), not secured to the floor.

Walker access to the bed is compromised on the right side: the nightstand sits tight against the bed and the bunched rug occupies the foot/right-side approach, leaving no clear, flat walker-width path to the bedside.
